observations: Tissue overlays align with the T1 anatomy across central and distributed sagittal, coronal, and axial slices.
Scalp and skull form visually continuous enclosing layers over the cranial vault in the reviewed slices.
Cortical gray matter, white matter, sulcal CSF, ventricular CSF, and posterior-fossa structures remain resolved at 1 mm.
Enclosed background regions correspond visually to expected nasal, sinus, orbital, and related air cavities and were not filled.
Outer and gray-matter first-hit projections are anatomically coherent after the 15-mm cranial envelope removed the superior wraparound or field-of-view artifact seen in rejected version 2.
No gross left-right flip, affine displacement, missing tissue class, collapsed CSF layer, or open cranial layer was observed.
reviewer: Codex visual QC in project workspace
scope_boundary: Visual anatomy acceptance does not validate optical properties, emitter registration, cortical ROI definitions, transport normalization, or clinical dosimetry.
